item.title: Artists tier launches: Studio, Professional, Represented
item.description: Working artists now have a dedicated home on Attesté: catalogue your studio, issue source certificates collectors trust, and publish a gallery-grade public profile. Studio at $14.99/mo with a 14-day trial.

item.title: Gallery tiers harmonised: Boutique, Professional, Enterprise — pure annual subscriptions
item.description: The Gallery Launch Kit retired in favour of clean annual SaaS tiers. Boutique at $495/yr (with 30% off year 1 for the first 25 founding galleries), Professional at $1,188/yr, Enterprise at $1,908/yr. No physical kit, no setup fees.

item.title: Collector pricing harmonised to $9.99 / $19.99 with annual savings
item.description: Collector and Premium are now USD-primary; available globally via App Store + Play Store with localised currency rendering. Annual plans save ~17% — Collector $99.99/yr, Premium $199.99/yr. Live on iOS and Android billing.
